sv.title: 12 000 evakuerade från konsert – misstänkt tårgas
sv.summary: Tusentals besökare fick evakueras under rapparen Don Tolivers konsert i Manchester. Enligt polisen misstänks någon ha släppt ut tårgas i publiken, rapporterar BBC.

en.title: 12,000 evacuated from concert – suspected tear gas
en.summary: Thousands of visitors had to be evacuated during rapper Don Toliver's concert in Manchester. According to police, someone is suspected of having released tear gas into the crowd, BBC reports.
